skills.source_skill: Summon Nether Imp / Summon Alchemic Golem
skills.delivery_notes: Permanent minion army (up to 6 Nether Imps + Alchemical Golem + pet). Minions are following companions not placed sentries — but pet-core identity means player damage is vestigial. lightning secondary from verify_ledger anchor: 'Ember Lightning casts a lightning bolt at foes, doing electric damage' — damage-type descriptor on generic noun, attested.

Channeled laser beam spell. Ember Lance anchor: 'casts a continuous blast of ember energy at your foes'. Secondary lightning from Ember Lightning spell (same kit). Alchemist holds back while minions engage.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Stationary caster directing pet/minion army; Ember Lance for supplemental channeled fire.

resource_economy.mana_resource: standard mana pool; no inverted-resource attested

traits_affixes: pet mastery doubles summon armor/attack bonuses (capstone_alterations anchor)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Pet-core summoner: minion army IS the damage identity — player has no primary damage rotation. Summoner-deferral applies. lightning secondary attested via Ember Lightning electric damage descriptor but NOT the build's primary identity (summoner, not caster). tl1 minimal source confirmed.

deviation_notes: Not that build — the player delegates all damage to minions; no player-driven skill loop is mappable without summoner architecture.

skills.delivery_notes: Arrow bounces off walls/environment for multi-hit. Verify anchor: 'The projectiles fired with it will bounce around, and the direction in which you fire it does have an impact on how many opponents it will hit.' Physical ranged — no element damage descriptor attested.
AoE burst projectile. Dossier anchor: 'Both are viable for very hard' (Ricochet vs Explosive Shot). Physical damage — no elemental descriptor attested.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Ranged physical archer: Ricochet wall-bounce as primary, Explosive Shot AoE flex, Arbiter trap supplements.

resource_economy.mana_resource: standard mana; no economy keys identity-load-bearing

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Ricochet wall-bounce claim: verify_ledger mechanics UNSUPPORTED for chain-hop claim specifically ('Ricochet is chain-hop NOT a line'); the confirmed anchor attests directional bounce, not fixed-hop chain. Geometry ricochet_bounce is correct. Chain-hop vs wall-bounce nuance: honest empty on chain vs wall-reflect. tl1 minimal source. Physical primary — no element attested.

deviation_notes: Wall-bounce detail (angle/reflect mechanic) not directly expressible in engine; ricochet_bounce geometry captures the shape. Explosive Shot secondary loop thinner than source.

skills.delivery_notes: Close-range twin-hit melee. Corpus elem_raw = physical. Fire Whirlwind variant converts to fire (item_alterations anchor: 'converting as much of its Damage from Physical to Fire') — but base loop is physical. No fire-damage-type descriptor on the primary non-variant identity.

Channeled AoE spin. Skill_geometry anchor: 'Whirlwind build tries to unlock the full potential of Whirlwind by converting as much of its Damage from Physical to Fire.' Shape = whirlwind; fire ONLY in the conversion variant, not the base physical loop.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Rage-accumulate melee loop: build Rage via hits/damage-taken → enter Berserk at max Rage → execute melee burst (Double Strike/Whirlwind). Fire-convert variant via elemental conversion items/talents.

resource_economy.charge_stack_resource: Rage (accumulates on-hit + on-damage-taken; auto-triggers Berserk at max)

traits_affixes: physical damage + attack speed scaling (mechanics anchor)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U (tli guide era stale) — mapping shape not era. Fire Whirlwind conversion is a named variant (T4 door ELEMENT_CONVERSION_MONO) not the base identity. Seething Spirit clone summons main skill for extra hits: proxy-rider, not pet-core. No element attested for base physical identity.

deviation_notes: Rage-auto-Berserk threshold mechanic approximated by charge-accumulator; exact Berserk stat-buff duration not expressible. Fire convert is T4 door variant, not base identity.

skills.delivery_notes: Primary cold projectile. Verify anchor: 'Cast Ice Lances as the main skill.' Cold identity attested: 'When using Cold Skills, Gemma will gain Cold Energy, which will increase Cold Damage and Frostbite Chance.' Frostbite → freeze: verify anchor 'with the goal of setting the maximum Frostbite to 100 to instantly freeze enemies.'
Ground AoE cold zone. Skill_geometry anchor: 'Always drop Frost Pool under the enemy to increase Ice Lance damage.' Enhances Ice Lance damage — ground zone mechanic.
On-kill AoE proc. Skill_loop anchor: 'When something dies, Frozen Lotus will proc and clear the entire screen of monsters.' On-kill cascade; cold element (Frost-family, cold Skills system).

mapping_json.motion_frame: Frost mage: cast Ice Lance main, proc Frozen Lotus on kill for clear, Frost Pool for boss damage amp. Stack Frostbite to 100 for freeze burst.

resource_economy.charge_stack_resource: Cold Energy (accumulates from Cold Skills use; increases Cold Damage and Frostbite Chance — item_alterations anchor)

traits_affixes: Seeping In (cold penetration in Frostfire Rampage)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U (guide era stale) — mapping shape. Frostbite stacking to 100 → instant freeze: Frostbite is TLI-specific stacking status that maps to freeze (hard CC threshold). Ice-Fire Fusion variant (dual-element) noted as T4 alternative but Frost-only is dominant loop. Frigid Transmission cooldown reset on freeze not fully expressible.

deviation_notes: Frostbite stacking threshold mechanic (0→100 → freeze burst) approximated; engine freeze is binary CC not a 100-stack ramp. Ice-Fire Fusion dual-element variant dropped (dominant cold loop wins per §7.2).

skills.source_skill: Thunder Magus (merged form) — Lightning Star / Thundercloud Surge / Lightning Surge
skills.delivery_notes: Hero merges with Spirit Magus to actively fight. Skill_geometry anchor: 'Thunder Magnus has a Base Skill of Lightning Star, an Empower Skill called Thundercloud Surge, an Enhanced Skill called Thunderlight Arrow, and an Ultimate skill called Lightning Surge.' Lightning attested: verify anchor 'Thunder Magnus ultimate skill damage scaling benefits from lightning damage increases.' Multi-projectile (Lightning Star/Arrow projectile type).
Support buff auras. Skill_geometry note: 'Machine Army summons front-line guard. Precise Projectiles and Weapon Amplification as passive auras.' Buff/support layer for the merged Thunder Magus form.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Hero merges into Thunder Magus form (Vigilant state) and actively fights using Magus projectile skills; cycle attack speed to trigger Lightning Surge ultimate rapidly.

resource_economy.cadence_scale: attack speed primary scaling (item_alterations anchor: 'attack speed greatly affects Magnus attack speed and ultimate skill cycle speed')

traits_affixes: Nourishment stacks for bonus damage (capstone anchor)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U. Hero-merge identity: Iris 2 is mode-swap (Vigilant = merged fighting form) — PHASE_MOMENTUM is the T4 door for the form cycling; PROXY_ASCENSION for the underlying spirit system. Iris 1 Growing Breeze (passive summon) is a separate identity, correctly excluded. Mode-swap docket candidate.

deviation_notes: Hero-merges-into-proxy form identity not fully expressible; engine has no hero-becomes-spirit-magus mechanism. Approximated as active projectile fighter with PHASE_MOMENTUM door.

Dominant variant in this kit is Thunder Magus.

Player support role. Skill_loop anchor: 'permanent minions tank and DPS while you support with auras and curses.' Auras include Precise Projectiles, Weapon Amplification. No element attested for aura skills.

Youga's aura/curse support role approximated but core damage is minion-only → GAPPED.

Verify anchor: 'After reaching their max range, Projectiles will return and travel an additional 75% of that distance, hitting the enemies on their path again.' Corpus elem_raw = physical; dossier capstone note: 'No inherent elemental type — skill selection determines element.' Physical = no family. Out-and-return = double-hit pass through pack.
Skill_geometry anchor: 'Projectiles can Jump off the ground, but cannot Jump toward enemies they have hit before.' Ground-bounce secondary mechanic (variant). No element.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Ammo-economy shotgun: fire multi-projectile volley, ammo auto-reloads every 0.6s (2 at a time), projectiles travel to max range then return through pack for second hit pass.

resource_economy.charge_stack_resource: Ammo (auto-reload 0.6s per 2 ammo; Ammo consumption triggers +50% damage bonus per skill_loop anchor)

economy: Fortitude damage multiplier on short-range variant

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U (SS12 rework context — map shape). Out-and-return projectile is a standing accrual family (addendum §B5 §E3). File: accrual to out-and-return family (carino2-lethal-flash). No element attested — skill-selection determines element in-source; honest null. Ground-bounce variant secondary skill noted, not dominant loop.

deviation_notes: Out-and-return double-hit trajectory has no direct engine geometry; multi_projectile captures the volley shape; return pass noted. Ammo reload economy approximated via cycle sub-shape.

Cold attested: verify anchor 'switch to the Frost Spike skill to enhance cold damage and utilize the Frostbite status ailment, with the goal of setting the maximum Frostbite to 100 to instantly freeze enemies.' Frostbite→freeze: 100-stack threshold → instant freeze = hard CC. water (cold-register).
Two-handed twin-blade combo. Skill_geometry anchor: 'Twin Blade Onslaught Enhances attacks using two-handed weapons.' Cold via Frost Spike / Frostbite stacking identity.

skills.source_skill: Cone of Cold / Frost Spike (cold-locked variant)
skills.delivery_notes: Cold primary attack. Skill_geometry anchor: 'the core gameplay typically revolves around Rosa 2 (Unsullied Blade) hero trait. It achieves high damage by stacking a massive amount of mana, combined with the hero trait, core unique items, and Cone of Cold skill.' Cold element via dossier variants: 'several cold damage skills are recommended: Frostbite, Frost Spike, Ice Bond.' Capstone: 'If the highest recorded damage type is Cold, it inflicts Cold Infiltration.' Dominant cold loop per Extreme Coldness talent — cold locked per capstone_alterations anchor.

Realm zone AoE that fires Mercury Baptism applying Infiltration. Skill_loop anchor: 'The Realm of Mercury records non-Channeled Attack Elemental Hit Damage dealt to enemies and casts Mercury Baptism on all enemies within it.' Cold Infiltration effect when cold = highest recorded type. Realm zone = placed area around Rosa.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Mana-stacking cold melee caster: accumulate Mystic Mercury via non-channeled elemental hits → enter Realm of Mercury → Mercury Baptism applies Cold Infiltration to all enemies in zone. Mana = primary damage scalar.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U. Corpus elem_raw = 'holy' — overridden by dossier cold-dominant evidence (cold Skills recommended; Extreme Coldness locks to cold; capstone confirms cold Infiltration). holy = name-only artifact from corpus probe; cold is the attested damage type in fetched dossier. Multi-elemental tracking identity (Infiltration = highest-recorded element) is a combination-determines-output mechanic — file docket. Mana stacking as stat-as-damage-substrate accrual: file 'accrual to stat-as-damage-substrate family' (tli-rosa-unsullied: mana stacking → damage scaling).

deviation_notes: Highest-element-tracking Mercury Baptism is a combination-determines-output mechanic with no engine lane; approximated as cold-primary per dominant loop. Mana-stacking as damage scalar not directly expressible in skill geometry. Mystic Mercury accumulator state has no engine exact.

skills.delivery_notes: Tri-elemental projectile: 3 bolts dealing Cold, Fire, or Lightning. Verify anchor: 'Chromatic Shot: Shoots 3 bolts that deal Cold, Fire or Lightning Damage and offers a chance for enemies to explode when defeated by this skill.' All three elements damage-type attested. Per §1 hybrids rule: triple+ → keep top-2 by scaling weight; per §7.2 dominant loop. No single dominant: fire/water/lightning equally tagged. Fire chosen primary (fire most commonly dominant element in tri-mix + kit description emphasizes tri-element balance); water (cold) secondary per erika3 precedent in this batch; lightning dropped with fidelity note. On-kill explosion: AoE proc on-kill.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Era-U (SS12 Lunaria guide). Tri-element identity: all three elements (cold/fire/lightning) are equally attested as damage types — this IS the kit's point (ELEMENT_CONVERSION_HYBRID). Per §1 triple-drop rule: fire=primary, water=secondary, lightning dropped (fidelity note: kit scales all three equally; tri-element is not reducible to a 2-slot summary without loss). Tangle variant (endgame broken interaction — era-stale) not included per era-U map-shape discipline.

deviation_notes: Tri-element identity (all 3 equally weighted) loses one element in 2-slot mapping; fire+water chosen by genre convention (cold and fire as the most common pair). Lightning dropped noted.
